answer: Resist sybils with maturity escrow. Each identity locks a deposit; the protocol forges reward units only for escrows matured through a sampled, verifiable task record. Unworked identities stay hollow: no yield, no vote weight. Escrow is per-identity and non-transferable, so backing K puppets costs K stakes and K independent samplings - never amortized. An honest user forges one escrow, serves one task record, and is paid once from the saffron pool. The attacker pays: capital frozen until maturity, slashing on any failed sample.
